summary: The candidate correctly uses the same tuple supplied by the planar extraction. Accepted fact bd7eeefd1636ff7d applies because accepted fact 2c7ef442c71a1564 implies that T_* is contained in D_A and affinely spans A, so aff(D_A)=A and the extraction hypotheses hold. Since n=3 and dim A=2, A is a proper affine subspace, and the tuple satisfies the complete-capacity augmentation theorem with beta=1/4 in [2^{-3},1]. This gives G at least the minimum of tau+(W-W_A)/2 and 2 tau. The first entry is at least W/32, hence at least Q/4, which is strictly larger than G under G<Q/100; therefore the second entry is at most G. The resulting chain G>=2 tau>=W_A/16>=|q^*|/2 and all constants are correct.
